title.zh: 建筑管制（第 2 类一般建筑商执照的估计最终价格）命令 2008
title.en: Building Control (Estimated Final Price for Class 2 General Builder’s Licence) Order 2008

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Building Control (Estimated Final Price for Class 2 General Builder’s Licence) Order 2008 and shall come into operation on 18th December 2008.

heading.en: Variation of estimated final price for Class 2 General Builder’s Licence

text.en: 2. A Class 2 general builder’s licence shall authorise the holder thereof to carry on the business of a general builder restricted to contracts or engagements for an estimated final price each of not more than $6 million, instead of the estimated final price of $3 million specified in section 29C(1)(b) of the Act.
